description: Synthetic calibration set for lesson retrieval: a research/engineering team's agent. Written and labelled by Claude Opus 5.5 (2026-09-26); same author for both, so results are optimistic. `relevant` = lessons that would materially help the agent's next reply. Hard negatives share vocabulary with a turn without helping it.

lessons.content: Alice Chen owns the billing pipeline; route invoice and payment-reconciliation questions to her, not to the platform team.
Production deploys are frozen from Thursday 18:00 to Monday 09:00 Pacific; hotfixes need sign-off from the on-call lead.
Service OAuth tokens for the data warehouse expire after 60 minutes; long batch jobs must refresh them or they fail midway with 401s.
The 'author' field in the papers database is free text and often lists first-name-last-name and last-name-comma variants of the same person.
The shared GPU cluster queue prioritizes jobs under 4 hours; split long training runs into checkpointed segments to avoid waiting days.
Architecture changes need an RFC in the #design stream with at least two approvals from different teams before implementation starts.
Bob Okafor works from Lagos (UTC+1) and prefers async written questions over meetings.
Eval results are only comparable across runs if the sampling seed and the prompt template version are both pinned in the run config.
The Zulip export drops messages edited after export time; for disputed history, check the raw database snapshot instead.
The foundation grant report is due on the 15th of each quarter's first month and must include compute spend broken down by project.
Priya Raman is the go-to person for tokenizer and embedding questions; she wrote the internal tokenizer library.
The staging database is refreshed from a sanitized production snapshot every Sunday night, so staging data is up to a week stale.
Internal reports use author-year citations and link arXiv IDs rather than DOIs.
The integration test 'test_ingest_large' is flaky under CI memory limits; a rerun usually passes, and a proper fix is tracked in issue 412.
Cloud spend over $2,000 per month on any single project needs pre-approval from the finance lead, Dana.
Research engineer interviews use a take-home replaced in 2025 by a paired debugging session; do not send candidates the old take-home.
Never log raw user prompts in production services; hash them or log only token counts, per the data-retention policy.
The retrieval index was built with 1024-dimensional embeddings; mixing in vectors from a different model silently corrupts nearest-neighbour results.
Team standup moved to 10:30 Pacific on Tuesdays and Thursdays only; other days are async updates in #standup.
Carol Diaz reviews all changes to the evaluation harness and tends to ask for ablations before approving.
Nightly backups exist for the papers database, but restores take about six hours; test on a copy before touching production.
Model weights under non-commercial licenses (e.g. CC BY-NC) cannot be used in anything shipped to the partner organization.
The team targets workshop submissions first and only extends to main-conference papers when results replicate on a second dataset.
The external annotation API allows 60 requests per minute per key; bulk labelling jobs must be throttled or they get banned for 24 hours.
Guest Wi-Fi at the office blocks outbound SSH; use the VPN or the lab network for cluster access.
New hires should start from the onboarding doc in the wiki's 'Start here' page, which is kept current; older READMEs are stale.
Sam Weber is on parental leave until mid-November; the ingestion service is covered by Priya in the meantime.
The eval metrics dashboard averages over seeds by default; toggle 'per-seed' to see variance before claiming an improvement.
Prompt templates live in the prompts/ directory with semantic version numbers; bump the minor version for any wording change.
Suspected credential leaks go to security@ immediately and the key is rotated before any investigation.
Vendor invoices must be PDFs named <vendor>-<YYYY-MM>.pdf and uploaded to the finance drive; emailed invoices get lost.
The internal tokenizer mis-splits URLs containing underscores; strip or pre-split URLs before counting tokens for budget estimates.
During the December holiday week only one on-call engineer covers all services; non-urgent requests wait until January.
The forum dataset may only be used for aggregate analysis; quoting individual posts in publications requires author consent.
Each team namespace in the Kubernetes cluster has a 64-CPU quota; request increases through the platform team's form, not Slack.
Decisions from the weekly research sync are recorded in the 'Decisions' wiki page; chat summaries are not authoritative.
The public inference API has a p95 latency SLO of 800 ms; changes that add model calls on the request path need a load test first.
Dana Kim leads finance and prefers budget questions batched into a single weekly email.
Before reporting a result, run the reproducibility checklist: pinned commit, pinned data version, seeds, and the exact command line.
The third-floor coffee machine is broken most Mondays; the second-floor one is reliable.

messages.text: One of our partner invoices from August doesn't reconcile with what we were charged. Who should I talk to?
It's Thursday evening and I've got a small config change ready. Can I push it to prod tonight?
My overnight warehouse export job keeps dying about an hour in with authentication errors. The first chunks succeed.
I'm counting papers per researcher from the papers DB and the numbers look off, like some people are split into two entries.
I submitted a 30-hour fine-tuning job to the cluster two days ago and it still hasn't started. Other people's jobs are running.
I want to replace our message queue with a different broker across all services. Can I just start on it next sprint?
I need Bob's input on the ingestion schema. Should I set up a call with him tomorrow at 4pm Pacific?
The new prompt gets 2 points higher on our benchmark than last week's run. Is that a real improvement?
Someone claims they posted the decision in the Zulip thread back in March, but I can't find it in our export. Did they misremember?
What do I need to prepare for the foundation's quarterly report, and when is it due?
Our token-count estimates for the crawl are way higher than the actual API usage, especially for pages full of links. Any idea why?
I created test records in prod on Wednesday but they're not in staging. Is the sync broken?
CI failed on test_ingest_large for my PR that only touches docs. What should I do?
We want to rent eight more GPUs for the ablation study, roughly $3,500 a month. Can I just go ahead?
I'm scheduling a research engineer candidate. Should I send them the take-home assignment from the hiring folder?
To debug the chat service I'd like to log every incoming prompt in full for a week. Any concerns?
I added some new documents to the search index using a smaller, faster embedding model, and now search results are garbage for everything.
The Jina v5 embedding model scores best on our benchmark. Can we use it in the tool we're delivering to the partner org?
I'm about to send 20,000 items to the annotation service in one go with a parallel script. Anything to watch out for?
The ingestion service is throwing errors. Should I page Sam?
Oops, I think I pasted our warehouse API key into a public GitHub gist an hour ago. I deleted it already.
For the paper I'd like to quote three really striking posts from the forum dataset as examples.
Our pods are stuck Pending with 'exceeded quota' in our namespace. How do I get more CPU?
I'd like to add a moderation model call before every response in the public inference API. Quick change, right?
I changed the evaluation harness scoring and I'm about to report the new numbers to the team.
I accidentally deleted a table in the papers database. Can we restore it from backup right now on prod?
A vendor emailed me their September invoice. What do I do with it?
Can I get the new dashboard feature reviewed and deployed during the December holiday week? It's not urgent but I'd like it out.
I tweaked two sentences in the grading prompt. Do I need to do anything else before running evals?
Our result looks strong on one dataset. Should we aim for the main conference deadline next month?
Can you help me rephrase this sentence so it sounds less formal: 'We hereby request your attendance.'
What's the difference between precision and recall, briefly?
Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
Thanks, that answer was great!
How do I reverse a list in Python?
Summarize the plot of Hamlet in three sentences.
I'm writing a blog post about the history of billing systems in telecom. Any good sources?
Explain how OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow works for a single-page app, in general terms.
What are good practices for running a productive team standup in general? I'm writing a management guide.
Which is better for coffee at home, a French press or pour-over?
I'm setting up a new nightly job that pulls from the data warehouse.
Sounds good. How long do you expect each run to take, and how will it authenticate?
About three hours, using the standard service OAuth token we get at the start.
I refactored how the harness aggregates per-task scores.
Did the headline numbers change?
Slightly up. I'm opening the PR now and want it merged today.
